# MCP tools (for AI apps)

![Integrations > Servers, where the REST API and MCP server are turned on](../assets/screens/page-servers.png)

An AI app connected to Cuebot's **MCP server** can use these tools. You do not call them yourself: the AI picks them when you ask it for something, like "make a !hello command". See [Your own AI app (MCP)](../guides/ai/ai-apps.md) for how to connect one.

**Asks first** means the tool can delete or change something big, or send a message. While **Confirm destructive tools** is ticked on **Apps > Servers**, Cuebot asks you (or makes the AI ask) before it does it. **Always** means it asks even when that box is not ticked, because it publishes something (a feature request on GitHub).

There are 119 tools.

## add_custom_widget

**Add custom widget.** Add a widget from code (StreamElements widget API: HTML, CSS, JS, fields JSON and data JSON; Streamlabs custom code works too). Fields become its settings form; {fieldKey} placeholders in the panes are filled in.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `overlay` (required) | text | Overlay id or name |
| `name` (required) | text | Widget name |
| `code` (required) | object | {html, css, js, fields, data}: text panes; fields and data are JSON objects as text |
| `place` | object | Optional: name, x, y, width, height (overlay pixels), opacity (0-1), rotation (degrees), visible, locked, enter / exit ({name, duration} or just the animation name) |

## add_media_request

**Add a media request.** Add a YouTube video to the media request queue (free, as the streamer).

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `link` (required) | text | YouTube link or video id |
| `user` | text | Who asked (default API) |

## add_quote

**Add a quote.** Add a quote (shown by !quote).

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` (required) | text | The quote |
| `user` | text | Who said it |
| `game` | text | Game or category (default the current one) |
| `platform` | text | Platform |

## add_store_item

**Add a store item.** Add an item viewers buy with Cuebot points.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (required) | text | Item name |
| `description` | text | What it is |
| `cost` (required) | whole number | Price in points |
| `currency` | text | Points currency (default the main one) |
| `stock` | whole number | How many (-1 = unlimited) |
| `needsApproval` | true/false | A moderator approves each redemption |
| `subscribersOnly` | true/false | Only subscribers |
| `userCooldownSeconds` | whole number | Per-viewer cooldown |
| `globalCooldownSeconds` | whole number | Cooldown for everyone |
| `enabled` | true/false | Default true |

## add_widget

**Add widget or layer.** Add one of Cuebot's widgets (kind from list_widget_kinds) or a text/image/video/slideshow layer to an overlay. settings are its first values (a widget's field keys from get_widget, or the layer's settings); place sets where it goes.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `overlay` (required) | text | Overlay id or name |
| `kind` (required) | text | alertbox, chatbox, label, goal, ..., or text, image, video, slideshow |
| `settings` | object | First settings, e.g. {"type": "follower", "prefix": "Latest follower: "} for a label |
| `place` | object | Optional: name, x, y, width, height (overlay pixels), opacity (0-1), rotation (degrees), visible, locked, enter / exit ({name, duration} or just the animation name) |

## apply_import

**Apply import.** Import a bundle. mode decides what happens to items that clash with existing ones (overwrite, addAsNew, skip); items can override single entries. Run preview_import first. Nothing in the import is run.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | text | The import string or bundle JSON |
| `mode` | one of `overwrite`, `addAsNew`, `skip` |  |
| `items` | list of object |  |
| `confirmationToken` | text | Only when a previous call answered confirmationRequired: the token it returned, after the user agreed |

## change_user_points

**Change a viewer's points.** add, remove or set a viewer's points.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `platform` (required) | text | Platform: twitch, youtube, kick, rumble... |
| `user` (required) | text | The viewer's user name (or user id) on that platform |
| `command` (required) | one of `add`, `remove`, `set` |  |
| `amount` (required) | whole number | Points |
| `currency` | text | Currency (default the main one) |

## connect_service

**Connect or disconnect a service.** Connect or disconnect a connection by its name from list_connections, using the sign-in and settings saved in Cuebot (it cannot sign in for the streamer; that is done on the service's page).

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (required) | text | Connection name, e.g. OBS, Twitch |
| `connect` (required) | true/false | true to connect, false to disconnect |

## control_alerts

**Control overlay alerts.** The alert queue on every overlay page: pause (the alert playing finishes, new ones wait), resume, skip the alert playing, mute or unmute alert sound; status only reads it.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` (required) | one of `status`, `pause`, `resume`, `skip`, `mute`, `unmute` |  |

## control_giveaway

**Close, draw or cancel the giveaway.** close stops entries; draw picks the winners; redraw picks one more; cancel ends it and refunds tickets.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` (required) | one of `close`, `draw`, `redraw`, `cancel` |  |

## control_media

**Control media requests.** skip the video playing, pause, resume, clear the queue (refunds), open or close requests.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` (required) | one of `skip`, `pause`, `resume`, `clear`, `open`, `close` |  |

## control_prediction

**Lock, resolve or cancel the prediction.** lock stops betting; resolve pays out to the winner (outcome number from 1 or its title); cancel refunds every bet.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` (required) | one of `lock`, `resolve`, `cancel` |  |
| `winner` | text | For resolve: outcome number from 1 or title |

## control_queue

**Control action queue.** pause (waiting runs stay waiting), resume, or clear (cancel the waiting runs) one queue, or every queue with queue "all".

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `queue` (required) | text | Queue name, "Default" or "all" |
| `command` (required) | one of `pause`, `resume`, `clear` |  |

## control_speech

**Control speech.** Cuebot's speech (TTS) queue: next stops the text playing and, while paused, lets exactly one waiting text play (pause, then next, steps through the queue one text at a time); pause, resume, skip; status only reads it.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` (required) | one of `status`, `next`, `pause`, `resume`, `skip` |  |

## create_action

**Create action.** Create an action. Pick trigger and sub-action types with list_trigger_types / list_subaction_types and check their parameters with describe_subaction_type first. Every parameter value is a string and may use %arguments%, ~globals~ and $functions()$ (resource cuebot://docs/variables). Unknown types or invalid values are rejected with a list of problems.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` (required) | object | The action. Example: {"name": "Greet", "triggers": [{"type": "command.triggered", "settings": {"command": "Hello"}}], "subActions": [{"type": "chat.send", "parameters": {"message": "Hi %user%!"}}]} |

## create_command

**Create command.** Create a chat command, e.g. {"name": "Hello", "commands": ["!hello"]}. To make it do something, add a trigger {"type": "command.triggered", "settings": {"command": "Hello"}} to an action.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` (required) | object |  |

## create_command_with_action

**Create command with its action.** Create a chat command and the action it runs in one step: the action automatically gets a command.triggered trigger for this command, so they are always linked. Prefer this to create_command plus create_action for a new command. Example: {"command": {"name": "Lurk", "commands": ["!lurk"]}, "action": {"subActions": [{"type": "chat.send", "parameters": {"message": "Thanks for lurking, %user%!"}}]}}. The action's name defaults to the command's; add other triggers if it should also run another way.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` (required) | object |  |
| `action` (required) | object | What the command does: at least subActions. The command.triggered trigger is added for you. |

## create_overlay

**Create overlay.** Create an empty overlay (a page OBS shows as a browser source).

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (required) | text | Name |
| `width` | whole number | Canvas width (default 1920) |
| `height` | whole number | Canvas height (default 1080) |

## create_queue

**Create action queue.** Add an action queue; actions join it with their "queue" field. A blocking queue runs its actions one at a time in order.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (required) | text | Queue name |
| `blocking` | true/false | One at a time (default false) |

## create_timer

**Create timer.** Create a timer, e.g. {"name": "Socials", "intervalSeconds": 600}. A timer only fires: run an action from it with a trigger {"type": "core.timer", "settings": {"timer": "Socials"}}.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timer` (required) | object |  |

## emulate_event

**Send a sample event.** Send a sample platform event with a made-up viewer, e.g. a Twitch follow or a Ko-fi membership to test the alert box. target "overlays" (default) shows it on every overlay only; "everything" publishes it as a real event so matching actions run too (they may post to chat). Events sent to everything are marked isTest: shown as tests in the feed and never counted in top spenders, while subathon timers and goals still count them.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `platform` (required) | text | twitch, kick, rumble, youtube, donations, kofi, patreon, fourthwall or shopify |
| `kind` (required) | text | twitch/kick/rumble/youtube: follow, sub, resub, gift, cheer, raid, tip, superchat, kicks or chat; donations: tip, merch, charity; kofi: tip, membership, resub, shop, commission; patreon: follow (free member), membership (new pledge), upgrade; fourthwall: tip, order, gifts; shopify: order. list_emulated_events has them all |
| `target` | one of `overlays`, `everything` |  |
| `args` | object | Override the sample's arguments (names from list_emulated_events), e.g. {"viewers": 75} for a raid or {"user": "Alice"} |

## end_poll

**End the chat poll.** End the running Cuebot chat poll now and show the result.

It takes no inputs.

## export_bundle

**Export bundle.** Build a Cuebot import string (CUEBOT1:...) for actions, commands, timers and globals (ids or names). Referenced items are included.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | list of text | Actions |
| `commands` | list of text | Commands |
| `timers` | list of text | Timers |
| `globals` | list of text | Global variables |
| `includeDependencies` | true/false | Include referenced actions, queues, commands... (default true) |
| `name` | text | Bundle name |

## export_overlay_package

**Export overlay package.** Write an overlay, or one of its layers, as a .cuebot-overlay package (canvas, widgets, settings, alert designs and images) to share. Saved to path when given (a new file on the computer running Cuebot), otherwise returned as base64 in data. Code of custom widgets (customWidgets lists them) is only included with includeCustomCode; Cuebot's own widgets always come along.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `overlay` (required) | text | Overlay id or name |
| `layer` | text | Only this layer, as a widget package (Layer id or name (get_overlay lists them)) |
| `includeCustomCode` | true/false | Include the code of custom widgets (default false) |
| `path` | text | File to create, ending in .cuebot-overlay |

| `search` | text | Name contains |
| `limit` | whole number | Maximum (default 25) |

## request_feature

**Request a feature.** File a feature request for Cuebot's developers as a PUBLIC GitHub issue (labelled enhancement), for something the streamer wants that Cuebot cannot do. Only after checking with the other tools that it really cannot (no trigger, sub-action, setting or workaround), and only when the streamer agrees to send one. Write it so a developer understands it without this conversation: what the streamer wants to do, what they tried or what Cuebot lacks, and a suggestion if there is one. Never include names, channel names, links to their accounts, tokens or other private details. Cuebot always shows the streamer the full text with Approve and Deny first.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (required) | text | Short summary, e.g. VTube Studio: throw items from the top (5 to 120 characters) |
| `body` (required) | text | The request in Markdown: what they want, why Cuebot cannot do it now, a suggestion (40 to 6000 characters) |
| `confirmationToken` | text | Only when a previous call answered confirmationRequired: the token it returned, after the user agreed |

| `command` (required) | one of `approve`, `reject` |  |

## run_action

**Run action.** Run an action now with optional arguments (available as %name% in its sub-actions). By default waits up to timeoutSeconds and returns the run (state, error, arguments after the run). The action may do anything it is built to do (chat, OBS...).

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` (required) | text | Action id or name |
| `args` | object | Arguments, e.g. {"user": "tester", "message": "hi"} |
| `wait` | true/false | Wait for the run to finish (default true) |
| `timeoutSeconds` | number | How long to wait (default 30, max 300) |

## run_subactions

**Run sub-actions now.** Run one or more sub-actions once, right now, without saving an action: anything in list_subaction_types (switch an OBS scene, set the stream title, speak text, time out a viewer, change a light, play a sound...). Same shape as an action's subActions (describe_subaction_type for the parameters). Waits for the result. To make it repeatable, create an action instead.

| Input | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `subActions` (required) | list of object | Sub-actions as in create_action, e.g. [{"type": "chat.send", "parameters": {"message": "hi"}}] |
| `args` | object | Arguments (%name%) the sub-actions can use |
| `queue` | text | Action queue to run in (default queue when empty) |
| `timeoutSeconds` | number | How long to wait (default 30, max 300) |
| `confirmationToken` | text | Only when a previous call answered confirmationRequired: the token it returned, after the user agreed |
